question: Please generate a summary of the closing balances at the end of each month for each customer transactions, show the monthly changes and monthly cumulative bank account balances. Ensure that even if a customer has no account activity in a given month, the balance for that month is still included in the output.
sql:
WITH months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(date_trunc('month', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS DATE) as month_start
    FROM customer_transactions
),
customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
month_customer AS (
    SELECT m.month_start, c.customer_id
    FROM months m
    CROSS JOIN customers c
),
monthly_net AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(date_trunc('month', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS DATE) as month_start,
        customer_id,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
            ELSE -txn_amount
        END) as monthly_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS DATE), customer_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.customer_id,
        mc.month_start,
        COALESCE(mn.monthly_change, 0) as monthly_change
    FROM month_customer mc
    LEFT JOIN monthly_net mn ON mc.customer_id = mn.customer_id AND mc.month_start = mn.month_start
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    CAST(month_start AS VARCHAR) as month,
    monthly_change,
    SUM(monthly_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) as closing_balance
FROM combined
ORDER BY customer_id, month_start
